chunks: In the narration of al-Sakūnī, he said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
A righteous child is a flower from the flowers of Paradise.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī; the narrator through whom this report is transmitted
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the abode of eternal reward
key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; referring here to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: a fragrant flower or sweet herb; something delightful and cherished

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about a righteous child?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the righteous child and presents such a child as a source of beauty, delight, and blessing. It highlights the spiritual value of children and encourages nurturing righteousness within the family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4688 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"A righteous child is a flower from the flowers of Paradise."
